- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 09:45, must finish by 22:15
- washing machine (washing_machine_2): ready from 09:45, must finish by 22:15
- tumble dryer (tumble_dryer_1): ready from 09:45, must finish by 22:15
- tumble dryer (tumble_dryer_2): ready from 09:45, must finish by 22:15
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 09:45, must finish by 22:15
